## PhD theses (6 co-supervised: 4 defended, 2 ongoing)

**Ongoing**

- **Soumaya Sabbehi** (2025–) — *Hybrid multimodal machine learning and knowledge graph system for predicting and monitoring Crohn's disease.*
  Joint PhD (cotutelle) between Université Paris Dauphine–PSL ([LAMSADE](https://www.lamsade.dauphine.fr)) and École Polytechnique de Tunisie (RISC laboratory);
  co-supervised with Safya Belghith (ENIT, director of the RISC laboratory).
- **Olivia Mu** (2024–) — *European decarbonisation targets for the automotive sector: which factors to reach them by 2050?*
  CIFRE PhD with AAAdata; co-supervised with Marc Baudry (EconomiX, Université Paris Nanterre).

**Defended**

- **Houria Braikia** (2022–2026) — *Multi-paradigm machine learning techniques to predict the ecological quality of marine environments from environmental DNA data.*
  Co-supervised with Marta Rukoz (LAMSADE), Dauphine–PSL doctoral contract. Defended on 28 April 2026 ([defence page](https://dauphine.psl.eu/formations/doctorat/soutenances/soutenance/application-de-techniques-dapprentissage-automatique-multi-paradigmes-pour-predire-la-qualite-ecologique-des-environnements-marins-a-laide-de-donnees-dadn-environnemental)).
- **Marwa Ben M'Barek** (2018–2022) — *Community detection in large networks: application to gene interaction networks.*
  Joint PhD with Université de Tunis El Manar; co-supervised with Marta Rukoz and Amel Borgi (LIPAH). Defended on 14 October 2022 ([defence page](https://dauphine.psl.eu/formations/doctorat/soutenances/soutenance/detection-de-communautes-dans-les-grands-reseaux-application-aux-reseaux-dinteractions-de-genes)). Best Student Paper Award, KES 2018.
- **Hmida Hmida** (2015–2019) — *Extending genetic programs for supervised learning from very large databases (Big Data).*
  Joint PhD with Université de Tunis El Manar; co-supervised with Marta Rukoz and Amel Borgi (LIPAH). Code: [gp-spark](https://github.com/hhmida/gp-spark).
- **Wafa Abdelmalek** (defended 2011) — *Forecasting implied volatility with genetic programming.*
  Co-supervised with Fathi Abid (MODESFI, Université de Sfax).

- G. Benjelloun (M2 IASD, Dauphine–PSL, 2019) — active sampling vs Spark parallelization for genetic programming.
